title: Preserve mixed capability routing in evidence-gap families
objective: Fix family consolidation so an observation already classified EXISTING_REPO_DERIVATION/BACKFILL_QUEUED is not represented as UNKNOWN_SOURCE/SOURCE_DISCOVERY_REQUIRED merely because another metric in the same family is unknown. Use only existing closure semantics.

evidence.summary: The family contains both EXISTING_REPO_DERIVATION/BACKFILL_QUEUED and UNKNOWN_SOURCE/SOURCE_DISCOVERY_REQUIRED observations, but family-level representation collapses the distinction.
The producer already supports the existing derivation and source-discovery routes; the defect is mixed-family consolidation.

reproduction: Read EG-MARKET-STRUCTURE observations and confirm mixed capability_hint and closure_state values.
Run family consolidation on a fixture containing one EXISTING_REPO_DERIVATION observation and one UNKNOWN_SOURCE observation.
Confirm the current aggregate loses the per-capability distinction.

positive: Mixed-family output preserves EXISTING_REPO_DERIVATION/BACKFILL_QUEUED and UNKNOWN_SOURCE/SOURCE_DISCOVERY_REQUIRED as distinct machine-readable routes.
Current family IDs, legacy observations and authority flags remain compatible.
negative: Do not create a new closure or policy state.
Do not convert genuinely unknown metrics into derivation-capable metrics.
Do not add sources, market thresholds or portfolio behavior.

post_fix_gate: CI and mixed-capability positive/negative fixtures must pass.
